## findings

**T0-1 SOURCE-FACTOR RED — the seeded release request is not producible by the charter, and a factor's tier rests on it.**
- Symptom: claims_requests 80561fbb (claims_depreciation_release_request, dwelling, related_job cb1a3090, 2026-07-01) carries requested_amount 410.00.
- Root cause: every non-IDR release "requests the depreciation withheld on the approvals of that coverage part less any depreciation already released on it" (base claims_evt_depreciation_release; IDR replaced_by). On 2026-07-01 the dwelling approvals d30b9a6c (withheld 6 120.00) and f785b4f7 (withheld 1 600.00, posted 2026-06-24) stood and nothing had been released, so the producible amount was 7 720.00.
- Consequence: IDR's pending_release_rule takes T1 from this row (410.00, gold 3 527.39). With the row the charter can produce, pending = 7 720.00 and IDR = MX(0, 7 273.80 − 2 218.01 − 600 − 168.40 − 7 720 − 50 − 300) = 0.00.
- Affected: initial_state.claims_requests.80561fbb; IDR computation step 19; design_rationale "earlier release request 410.00 naming the water job".
- Previous revision: none (first revision).

**T0-2 SOURCE-POLICY RED (CG-13 restated in the proof) — the proof asserts a world fact no record carries.**
- prerequisite_closure E2 why_false: "credits on lines the code-upgrade approval paid for".
- solvability_contract step 15 discriminator: "adjustment credits on lines the code-upgrade approval paid for".
- No row links approval f785b4f7, or its request 56dee85e (one amount, 1 650.00), to water charge lines dfcb5d91 or 29ab4ef5. The goodwill credit a85d4097 has no source_charge_id at all, yet it is counted (CWW goodwill tier).
- Consequence: as demonstrated under CG-13, CWW 386.20 → IDR 3 587.39 → CRS 665.62 under the sentence's line-scoped reading.
- Affected: CRS and IDR rule sentences; task 0 prerequisite_closure E2/E4; solvability_contract step 15.

**T0-3 SOURCE-FACTOR RED (proof text) — a false world assertion.** design_rationale "WORLD ROWS" says "Water job (Gray Water Standard, 1974): 36 charge lines". initial_state.water_charges carries 33 rows. No scored value moves, but the proof sentence is false as written.

- CG-7: CWW 0.00 under the base meaning, so the CRS and IDR gates never open.
